limits: Temporary homes and synthetic fixture content; the schema half uses hand-written manifests. The balance-report checks are exercised on hand-made rows (the balancer is T007), the terms-decision branch only as a refusal (OD-1 deferred). The scan is the SPEC-074 post-redaction scan; canary corpus coverage is T010. redactionVersion covers only the redactor's pattern sources and salt size, not its code. jsonschema is a development dependency; the runtime stays standard-library only.
outcome: passed: T006 part: export_dataset writes exactly records.jsonl and manifest.json for both kinds at both levels (supervised with and without the outcome field), the manifest file is the canonical manifest bytes plus a newline and every manifest validates against the schema; recordsSha256 is the SHA-256 of records.jsonl and each record entry's sha256 and recordId match its line (SC-003's manifest half); redactionVersion is spec074-redact/<16 hex> of the SPEC-074 redactor's pattern sources and salt size, stable across calls and different when a token pattern or the salt size changes; termsDecision is null, canaryScan clean, balance none with an empty report, exclusions count the content-free call, retention gives each cited run its retentionDays and expiry date, and digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical manifest without generatedAt and digest. Each check inside check_manifest refuses (invalid-manifest) when tested directly: a wrong records or record hash, a record id not in its line, an unordered turn range, unsorted limits, retention missing a cited run or citing another, a duplicate balance-report task, a single-outcome task that keeps records, a supervised export with balance exclusions or balance equal, a host-model record labelled fixture, a host-model record without a terms decision, an unscanned manifest, an extra line and a stale digest; through export_dataset, a retention map missing a cited run and a writer entry with a wrong hash are refused with invalid-manifest and nothing is written. Negative controls (mutants, each fails a test): generatedAt inside the digest, the scan removed, each builder check removed, the check_manifest call unhooked from the builder, a fixed redaction version. T002 part: the schema passes Draft 2020-12 check_schema. Accepted: a rollout manifest at both levels, a supervised manifest (balance none, empty balance report), a host-model manifest with a terms decision, local-model records without one, attempt ids of the four SPEC-074 pseudonym kinds, retentionDays 1 and 90 and relative terms paths. Refused: a missing record sha256 or redactionVersion or an empty redactionVersion; any missing top-level, record, exclusion, balance-report, retention-entry or terms-decision field and an unknown key in each of those objects; a negative exclusion, balance-report or turn-range counter; retentionDays 0, 91 or 1.5; an expiry that is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date and a generatedAt that is not a valid UTC second; an absolute, dotted, whitespace, home, drive, empty or 257-character terms path and an uppercase terms sha256; an attempt id of wrong length, case or kind or a raw id; malformed run, task, group and rollout ids; unknown version, kind, level, balance (ratio included: OD-2), ordering key, canary result, exclusion reason, source, outcome or limit; a duplicate limit; a consent level other than redacted; a malformed digest, record hash, record id or turn range; no records; balance none or a supervised export with a non-empty balance report; a balanced supervised export; host-model records without a terms decision.
